yt.title: Unix time hits 2,000,000,000 seconds on May 18, 2033 (UTC) #Shorts
yt.description:
Unix time counts seconds since January 1, 1970 UTC. Python: datetime.fromtimestamp(2,000,000,000, UTC) = May 18, 2033, 03:33:20 UTC. It passed 1,000,000,000 on September 9, 2001.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Many computers keep time as one big number: the seconds since January first, nineteen seventy.

scenes.label: the day that count reaches 2,000,000,000
scenes.narration: That count reaches two billion on May eighteenth, twenty thirty-three, at three thirty-three and twenty seconds, U T C.

It passed one billion on September ninth, two thousand and one. Two billion is still below the thirty two bit limit of about two point one four billion, so it fits. The real trouble is twenty thirty-eight, when that limit runs out.
Mark the date. Where will you be when the clock hits two billion?
